home.tagline: Taiwan Forest Trust Commons · Open-source digital MRV infrastructure for forest carbon
home.title: Every forest carbon claim, verifiable by anyone, for free
home.intro: GreenChain Timber turns plot boundaries, sequestration estimates, and attestation records into open data any third party can independently verify — fully open source, with auditable coefficient and layer versions, building a foundation of verifiable honesty for Taiwan's natural carbon sinks.

s1.title: Digital plot registration
s1.desc: Trace plot boundaries point-by-point on a 3D satellite map; geometry is normalized automatically

s2.title: Spatial overlap checks
s2.desc: PostGIS compares against existing plots in real time; overlapping areas are highlighted in red on the spot

s3.title: Official formula estimates
s3.desc: Estimates current and 5-year sequestration using the Ministry of Environment methodology framework and Ministry of Agriculture coefficients

s4.title: Attestation & public verification
s4.desc: Geometry fingerprints and carbon tonnage go on-chain; anyone can recompute and compare

a1.title: Citizens & conservation groups
a1.desc: Public verification without sign-in: anyone can recompute geometry fingerprints and check coefficient versions and estimation bases — holding forest carbon claims accountable without trusting any institution.

a2.title: Aggregators & regulators
a2.desc: A spatial-governance foundation for co-ops, associations, and production groups aggregating multiple forest owners — non-overlapping boundaries, double-counting prevention, and computable, attestable contribution shares.

a3.title: Companies & environmental consultants
a3.desc: A continuous monitoring dashboard for afforestation and adoption projects; every figure carries its formula version and attestation link, ready for sustainability reports, due diligence, and verification bodies to check independently.

boundaries.title: What we don't do (positioning & boundaries)
boundaries.b1: This platform presents measurement and monitoring data for carbon storage and sequestration; estimates are not, and do not constitute, verified emission-reduction credits.
boundaries.b2Strong: No monetization claims for natural forests.
boundaries.b2: For natural and secondary forests, the platform provides carbon-storage monitoring and ecological-value display only, with no carbon-credit monetization claims.
boundaries.b3: Trading of emission-reduction credits is regulated by the competent authority; this platform takes no part in matching or commissions, providing only the open-data trust infrastructure that precedes credit issuance.
boundaries.b4: In Taiwan, voluntary reduction projects may only be applied for by businesses, governments, and associations — not individuals; smallholders participate via aggregators. This platform is a data foundation for companies and aggregators, not a personal monetization channel.
